name: Lady Lobe
source:
Lady Lobe is one of the employees at the Ghoul's Grove. She seems to be drunk almost all the time and has quite a violent and unpredictable personality. She seems to have a strong dislike towards Darcy and Head Cadaver, but close and friendly to Airhead.

In her regular outfit, she wears a bowler hat with razors in the teal ribbon, a black and teal clown costume, gloves, white face paint with her facial muscles visible on the edges of her head, and her right eye socket holds a cue ball. She often carries a nailed baseball bat with her and broken glass bottles on her waist, keeping her threatening appearance.
